name: Data Center Capacity
description: Size the market for enterprise data center capacity.
formula: SAM = Population x Penetration Rate x Purchase Frequency x Average Spend x Serviceable %
solution_logic: Step 1: Identify addressable population = target_population x addressable_segment
Step 2: Apply penetration rate = addressable_population x penetration_rate
Step 3: Calculate annual spend per user = purchase_frequency x avg_spend_per_purchase
Step 4: Calculate TAM = penetrating_users x annual_spend_per_user
Step 5: Calculate SAM = TAM x serviceable_pct
key_insight: The population is enterprises, not people -- and purchase frequency is structurally one contract per year, so the real judgment call is the addressable % that needs added capacity right now, not a frequency assumption.
common_mistakes: Sizing the general population instead of mid-market enterprises specifically
Second-guessing purchase frequency when it's structurally fixed at one contract/year -- the real levers are contract value and addressable %
Ignoring the new region's service radius (serviceable %), which caps demand regardless of national enterprise count
framework_soundbite: Enterprises, not people; one contract each -- the market moves on addressable % and deal size, not frequency.
business_contexts: a cloud infrastructure provider evaluating a new data center region
a private equity fund sizing demand for colocation capacity
question_patterns: A cloud infrastructure provider is deciding whether to open a new regional data center and wants to size the serviceable portion of annual demand within that region's reach.

serviceable_pct.unit: % within the new region's service radius

prompts.advanced: An infrastructure fund is evaluating a colocation operator whose growth story depends on enterprise capacity demand the fund's own technical advisors are divided on. Build an independent serviceable-addressable-market view before the investment committee meets.
prompts.beginner: Estimate the serviceable addressable market for enterprise data center colocation capacity within a single new region.
prompts.intermediate: A cloud infrastructure provider is deciding whether to open a new regional data center and wants to size the serviceable portion of annual demand within that region's reach.
